# Agent Pack Delivery Notes

The canonical source is under `.apm/`. Vendor targets are generated under `targets/` and archives under `dist/`; edit canonical content and rebuild rather than editing generated targets.

The primary agent has the complete trainer capability set. Specialist agents are optional and should be used for focused review, not as hidden prerequisites. Tools are environment capabilities, not guarantees of authorization or connectivity.

Every delivery report must distinguish source evidence, static inspection, a rehearsed local result, a live tenant result, and an unverified assumption.
